text:
maria-eng: Proposal — build a unified dashboard that shows per-pool SM occupancy heatmap, memory headroom, and queue depth for both Hosted + Dedicated pools. Need agreement on sources and cardinality.

jay-platform: +1. Main questions: which service emits SM occupancy? runtime or infra exporter? we currently have per-GPU metrics in node-exporter and sm stats from runtime.

leo-mlinfra: runtime emits per-SM occupancy and block-level memory usage at 1s granularity (metric: runtime_sm_occupancy{pool,device,sm}). Node exporter has cuda memory but not SM heatmaps.

tara-pm: We need to expose per-pool aggregated headroom to the console (for capacity planning) and a per-pool alert when queue depth > X for > 2m. UX wants a compact heatmap + histogram.

deploy-bot: New metric ingestion job scheduled: gpu-metrics-forwarder started by @ops at 2026-03-10T15:02Z

maria-eng: Suggest metrics we surface:
 - runtime_sm_occupancy_percent{pool,device,sm}
 - runtime_sm_queue_depth{pool,queue}
 - runtime_memory_free_bytes{pool,device}
 - runtime_memory_total_bytes{pool,device}
 - pool_pending_requests{pool}

jay-platform: How about rollup keys? For Dedicated we must include customer_id tag. That increases cardinality. We should avoid per-customer per-device heatmaps in dashboard — stick to per-pool and per-device; provide per-customer drilldown in a separate view.

leo-mlinfra: Agree. Also sampling rules: store 1s raw for 10m then downsample to 15s. Example PromQL for occupancy 95th percentile:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_sm_occupancy_percent[5m])) by (pool))
```

tara-pm: Can we get a simple mockup? I sketched: left: heatmap (pool x SM index), top-right: time-series of queue depth + pending requests, bottom-right: memory headroom gauge + alerts.

maria-eng: Action items:
 - leo: confirm retention and downsample windows for runtime exporter (due Tue)
 - jay: add customer_id tag policy and docs for Dedicated (due Wed)
 - tara: mockup + requirements (due Fri)
 - I'll open a dash ticket and link the ingest change.

jay-platform: One more: rate limit cardinality in the ingest pipeline. If we see > 10k new label combos/hr, fallback to aggregated keys and emit a warning to the team.

maria-eng: sounds good. I'll create the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-2345 and tag the metrics work. :thumbsup:

leo-mlinfra: noted, will post a short snippet for the exporter config once I confirm the retention.

tara-pm: thanks everyone — small sync tomorrow 9:30 to review mockup and alert thresholds :calendar:
